title: Design System: Disney Speedstorm Racer Shard Calculator

shadows.name: update-notice
shadows.purpose: Elevates the fixed update notice above page content.

motion.name: choice-transition
motion.purpose: Color transitions for radio-choice surfaces and outlines.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables animations, transitions, and smooth scrolling when requested.

components.name: Update button
components.description: Action in the fixed notice to install a new version.
components.css: .ds-update { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: #091724; color: #edf4fa; font: 600 14px 'Barlow', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-update svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-update:hover { color: #65e3ef; } .ds-update:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #65e3ef; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Racer Shards inventory
components.description: Numeric Racer Shard and Tune Coin inventory fields with matching currency icons, labeled units, and adjacent validation.
components.css: .ds-balance { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; padding-inline: 15px; border: 1px solid #30485c; border-radius: 6px; background: #091724; } .ds-shard { width: 18px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; color: #65e3ef; } .ds-balance input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding-block: 12px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #edf4fa; font: 400 19px 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; caret-color: #65e3ef; } .ds-unit { color: #abc0d1; font: 400 13px 'Barlow', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-balance:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #65e3ef; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-balance:has(input[aria-invalid='true']) { border-color: #ffb6b6; }

components.name: Upgrade summary
components.description: Prominent Racer Shards still-needed count with a parallel Tune Coin balance summary and dual-currency Star breakdown. Partial targets include the full Stars and Star Fragments, with wrapping text on narrow screens.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-result { color: #edf4fa; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; } .ds-result-label { color: #abc0d1; font-size: 15px; } .ds-result-value { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: #ffda6a; } .ds-result-value > svg { width: 36px; height: 46px; transform: rotate(8deg); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-result-value strong { font: 600 96px/1.08 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-result p { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 18px; } .ds-result.is-complete .ds-result-value { color: #65e3ef; }

components.name: Target Star Fragments
components.description: Native radio choices for 0–4 target fragments toward the next Star, matching current-progress controls. Changing target Stars resets fragments; six Stars disables them.
components.html:
Target Star Fragments

components.css: .ds-fragments { border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; min-width: 0; color: #edf4fa; font-family: "Barlow", sans-serif; } .ds-fragments legend { padding: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-choices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-choice { position: relative; min-width: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; inset: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 47px; border: 1px solid #30485c; border-radius: 6px; background: #091724; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-choice input:checked + span { background: #173d4b; border-color: #65e3ef; color: #65e3ef; } .ds-choice input:hover:not(:disabled) + span { border-color: #65e3ef; } .ds-choice input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid #65e3ef; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-choice input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-choice input:disabled + span { color: #93a6b5; background: #172735; border-color: #3a4a59; } .ds-fragments p { color: #abc0d1; margin-top: 9px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-choice span { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A compact, practical dashboard for checking a Racer’s next Star upgrade. Deep navy supports a focused, low-glare reading scene. Barlow Condensed carries the display and large numeric result; Barlow keeps controls, help, and explanations readable. Cyan identifies selection and focus. Yellow identifies Stars and outstanding Racer Shards.

Racing cues live in small geometric marks, the faceted shard icon, and a checkered finish marker. The calculator and its result occupy the first viewport. Explanatory content follows below.
keyCharacteristics: Layered navy-blue surfaces with fine blue outlines.
Consistent distinction between cyan interactions and yellow Stars or shard counts.
Original local SVG geometry; no remote images or image-like decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks selection and interaction. Yellow marks Stars and Racer Shards still needed.

dos: **Do** reserve cyan for focus and selection, and yellow for Stars and the prominent Racer Shards result.
**Do** call inventory currencies **Racer Shards** and **Tune Coins**, and unlocked progress **Star Fragments**.
**Do** retain Barlow Condensed for display numbers and Barlow for body and controls.
**Do** keep native controls and a visible keyboard focus ring.
**Do** stack the form and summary below `680px`.
donts: **Don't** use yellow for the selected state or cyan for the missing-shards result.
**Don't** rely on color alone for selection, focus, errors, or disabled choices.
**Don't** add shadows to the main panels or substitute Unicode text for icons.
